title.en: Explain a 4:1 multiplexer and write its output expression
Relate select lines to the number of inputs or outputs

say.en: A TV remote has one infrared beam but dozens of buttons; a telephone line carries many calls. A multiplexer picks one of many inputs, and a demultiplexer sends one input to the right output. In this lesson: Explain a 4:1 multiplexer and write its output expression.
Explain a 1:4 demultiplexer.
Relate select lines to the number of inputs or outputs.

body.en: A *multiplexer* (MUX) has $2^n$ data inputs, $n$ select lines and one output. The binary number on the select lines decides which input is connected to the output. For a 4:1 MUX, $Y = \bar{S_1}\bar{S_0}I_0 + \bar{S_1}S_0I_1 + S_1\bar{S_0}I_2 + S_1S_0I_3$. It is built from AND gates (one per input, enabled by one select combination) feeding an OR gate. ICs: 74151 (8:1), 74153 (dual 4:1). Uses: data selection, parallel-to-serial conversion, realising Boolean functions.

narration.en: A multiplexer is a data selector. With n select lines it chooses one of two to the power n inputs and connects it to the single output.
narration.kn: ಮಲ್ಟಿಪ್ಲೆಕ್ಸರ್ ಒಂದು ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಆಯ್ಕೆಗಾರ. n ಆಯ್ಕೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳಿಂದ 2ⁿ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ ಏಕೈಕ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ಗೆ ಜೋಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: A multiplexer is a data selector. With n select lines it chooses one of two to the power n inputs and connects it to the single output. 2 to the power n inputs, n select lines, 1 output.

title.en: MUX and DEMUX symbols and select tables

say.en: The multiplexer symbol is a trapezium. Four data inputs enter on the left and one output leaves on the right.
The select lines S1 S0 form a 2-bit number. That number names the input that reaches Y.
Each term of the output equation is one input ANDed with its select code.

draw.tex: Y = \bar S_1\bar S_0I_0 + \bar S_1S_0I_1 + S_1\bar S_0I_2 + S_1S_0I_3

say.en: The demultiplexer is the mirror image: one input D, four outputs, and the same select lines.
For select code 1 0, only Y2 carries the data; the other outputs stay at 0.

body.en: A *demultiplexer* (DEMUX) does the reverse: one data input D, $n$ select lines and $2^n$ outputs. The select code decides which output receives D; all others stay 0. For a 1:4 DEMUX, $Y_0 = D\bar{S_1}\bar{S_0}$, $Y_1 = D\bar{S_1}S_0$, $Y_2 = DS_1\bar{S_0}$, $Y_3 = DS_1S_0$. A decoder with an enable input works as a demultiplexer (e.g. IC 74155). Uses: serial-to-parallel conversion, sending data to one of many destinations.

problem.en: An 8:1 multiplexer has select inputs S2 S1 S0 = 1 0 1. Which input appears at the output? How many select lines does it have?

steps.en: An 8:1 MUX has 8 = 2³ inputs, so it needs 3 select lines.
S2 S1 S0 = 101 in binary = 5 in decimal.
So input I5 is connected to the output Y.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. An 8:1 multiplexer has select inputs S2 S1 S0 = 1 0 1. Which input appears at the output? How many select lines does it have?

say.en: Let us work this out together. An 8:1 multiplexer has select inputs S2 S1 S0 equals 1 0 1. Which input appears at the output? How many select lines does it have?
An 8:1 MUX has 8 equals 2 cubed inputs, so it needs 3 select lines.
S2 S1 S0 equals 101 in binary equals 5 in decimal.
So input I5 is connected to the output Y.
So the answer is Y equals I5; 3 select lines.

problem.en: Use a 4:1 MUX to realise Y = A ⊕ B, with A on S1 and B on S0. What must be connected to I0–I3?

steps.en: With A B as the select code, input Ik appears when AB = k.
So connect I0 = 0, I1 = 1, I2 = 1, I3 = 0.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Use a 4:1 MUX to realise Y = A ⊕ B, with A on S1 and B on S0. What must be connected to I0–I3?

say.en: Let us work this out together. Use a 4:1 MUX to realise Y equals A ⊕ B, with A on S1 and B on S0. What must be connected to I0-I3?
With A B as the select code, input Ik appears when AB equals k.
A ⊕ B equals 0, 1, 1, 0 for AB equals 00, 01, 10, 11.
So connect I0 equals 0, I1 equals 1, I2 equals 1, I3 equals 0.
So the answer is I0 equals 0, I1 equals 1, I2 equals 1, I3 equals 0.

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. A MUX selects one of 2 to the power n inputs using n select lines.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. MUX n ಆಯ್ಕೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳಿಂದ 2 to the power n ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದನ್ನು ಆರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: A DEMUX sends one input to one of 2 to the power n outputs.
say.kn: DEMUX ಒಂದು ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಅನ್ನು 2 to the power n ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
